analytics.name: Analytic 1903
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol commands changing device-level credentials or access codes from a source not in the approved security administration list, where the device subsequently rejects connections from legitimate control system components. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.

tuning.description: Accounts authorized to change credentials for ICS service and operator accounts.
